description: Read volume, difficulty, CPC and competition for up to 1,000 terms that are already tracked for one site. Fresh rows reuse the 30-day metrics cache; only stale or missing terms hit DataForSEO. Never creates a report (reportId is always null). Paid: the account's own DataForSEO key or included platform credits, billed per request by DataForSEO. Priority input only, never verification. confirm:true plus idempotencyKey is required to execute. Requires the research:write scope.
name: get_keyword_metrics
title: Volume, difficulty and CPC for tracked keywords
